tools.name: list_formats
tools.description: List every file format this converter reads or writes (id, name, extensions, family). Use the id values as `from`/`to` in other tools.

tools.name: check_conversion
tools.description: Check whether one format can be converted to another before sending a file. Returns the engine, whether AI Deep Read is needed, the options it accepts, and alternatives when the pair is not supported. Formats accept ids (docx), extensions (jpeg) or common names (word, excel).

tools.name: list_conversions
tools.description: List supported target formats for a source format (or every source that can produce a target). Returns compact {from,to,slug,engine,mode} rows.

tools.name: convert_file
tools.description: Convert a file. Provide the content as base64 OR a public https URL. `from` is optional when the filename/URL has an extension. Text outputs (Markdown, CSV, JSON, HTML…) up to 200 KB are returned inline as `text`; other outputs are returned as `base64` plus a `downloadUrl` that accepts the same bear

tools.name: get_conversion
tools.description: Fetch a previous conversion by id: status, warnings, and the output (inline text or base64) if it is still retained.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "convert_file" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
